profiles.purpose: Build a static site and publish it under /all-apps/<repository-name>/.
profiles.limitations: Publishes a static directory. Does not start a Node.js server or a container.

capabilities.purpose: Tag-styled af-theme, af-heading, and af-panel elements, plus the shared colour, space, and type tokens.
capabilities.integration: After publication, pnpm add @app-framework/ui. Import @app-framework/ui and @app-framework/ui/styles.css from a client component and call defineAppElements() inside useEffect.

compatibility.notes: Registry install waits until the npm scope is confirmed and this package is published.

capabilities.purpose: Typed environment values, with server-only values kept out of browser-safe output.
capabilities.integration: After publication, pnpm add @app-framework/app-config. Call defineConfig, loadConfig, and loadPublicConfig from application code.

compatibility.notes: Registry install waits until the npm scope is confirmed and this package is published.

capabilities.purpose: framework-check reports published framework package versions. framework-setup validates an application configuration and applies the capabilities that can be configured.
capabilities.integration: After publication, pnpm add -D @app-framework/dev-tools and add the script framework:setup. Until then, run the built CLI from a checkout of this repository.

compatibility.notes: Registry install waits until the npm scope is confirmed and this package is published.

capabilities.purpose: Shared Cursor rules for naming, separation, TypeScript, organisation, testing, and maintainability.
capabilities.integration: framework-setup copies standards/cursor/rules into .cursor/rules/framework and writes .cursor/framework-standards.json.

compatibility.notes: Rules outside .cursor/rules/framework stay in the application. The interface rule in this repository stays here.

capabilities.purpose: Publish a static directory to /all-apps/<repository-name>/ with versioned releases and rollback.
capabilities.integration: A caller uses workflow_call on Clain-Apps/App-Framework/.github/workflows/deploy-static.yml at main or deploy-static-vN. The implementation stays in this repository.

compatibility.notes: Static files only. The workflow does not start a Node.js server or a container. Calling it requires the workflow file on the default branch.

capabilities.purpose: Version and publish the framework packages with Changesets. Applications do not run this workflow.
capabilities.integration: The release workflow in this repository publishes after the npm scope is confirmed. Applications bump their own dependency ranges.

compatibility.notes: Runs in this repository. Setup rejects an application that selects it.
